name: storm-print
title: Storm Print
description: Rain, lightning and ordered dither. A strike or a click reprints the picture in color inks cut from it.

props.description: A figure that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. A cross-origin image needs CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).

props.name: focus
props.description: Point of the image kept in frame when the crop fills the stage. 0 to 1, y counted from the top.

props.name: ink
props.description: Shadow tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: dither
props.description: Threshold pattern. Halftone prints a 45 degree dot screen.

props.name: print
props.description: ink prints two tones and turns to color on a strike. color always prints in color.

props.name: cell
props.description: Dither cell in CSS px.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Raise it to ink more of the frame, lower it to ink less.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Contrast of the tone curve.

props.name: rain
props.description: Rain amount, 0 to 1. 0 turns it off.

props.name: rainSpeed
props.description: Rain speed multiplier.

props.name: rainAngle
props.description: Rain slant in degrees.

props.name: lightning
props.description: Storm strikes on a timer. Off leaves clicks and the strikes prop as the only triggers.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Strike rate, 0 to 1. Strikes stay at least three seconds apart.

props.name: flash
props.description: Flash strength, 0 to 1.

props.name: colorHold
props.description: Seconds a strike holds the color print before it fades back. Infinity never fades.

props.name: aura
props.description: Strength of the aura around the pointer. 0 turns it off.

props.name: auraRadius
props.description: Aura radius multiplier.

props.name: strikes
props.description: Increase it to fire a strike from code. A click on the stage fires one too, with a shaking burst ring.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds one still frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.default: "A picture printed as an ordered dither, reprinted in color by lightning strikes and clicks"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the stage a size.
Full-frame plane without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View. Reads state.pointer and pointer down events. The aura follows the pointer and fades after 2.5 seconds without a move.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Reduced motion draws one still frame with no flashes, no rain and no strikes. Set print to color to show the color print.
Without WebGL it shows the source image in grayscale.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

animation.properties: Sky lift, bolt and color print mix in the fragment shader
animation.timing: At most two pulses in 0.9 s, color fades after the hold
animation.trigger: Timer, click or the strikes prop. Strikes stay 3 s apart on the timer and 1 s apart by hand.

docs: Requires React 19 and an image your page can read as a texture. Render <StormPrint src="/photo.jpg" className="w-full max-w-xl" /> anywhere. StormPrint owns a Canvas, so mount StormPrintScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one. The color palette is cut from the image in the browser, so the image must be readable by canvas (same origin or CORS).
